scope: Isolated hosted Fidy Core Queue handoff with synthetic D1 rows and real no-op child Workflows. Measures eight-message handoff service time, not Queue waiting, extraction completion, erasure-recovery wrapper latency, or global API throughput. No public ingress or application provider bindings.

method.sourceBaseline: Exact historical queue dispatcher with its matching error-unwrapping runtime; shared current owner implementations/dependencies.
method.timing: Effect monotonic Clock inside the same parent Workflow step; seed time and control-plane polling excluded.
scopeLimits: No public ingress, application financial data or real extraction/email bindings.

Handoff service throughput only; not Queue waiting, extraction completion, or maximum account-wide throughput.
